dedupe_keys.name: classes de trafic vehicules poids lourds sur la voirie departementale en haute garonne

description: Classes de trafic véhicules poids lourds sur la voirie départementale en Haute-Garonne is a dataset listed in Open Data Haute-Garonne, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Conseil départemental de la Haute-Garonne. La connaissance du trafic des véhicules poids lourds est indispensable pour dimensionner les structures de chaussées. Selon l’importance du trafic poids lourds moyen journalier on définit plusieurs classes de trafic, de T5 à T0. Coverage: Haute-Garonne. The portal files it under Déplacements. Its keywords are Comptage routier, Poids lourds, Routes départementales, Trafic routier, Voirie, Circulation. The portal shows 5,258 records. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-haute-garonne-fr-portal.
